expected_graph.activation_rule: For every supported cell, the normalized observed public graph MUST equal the corresponding expected projection exactly. Missing and extra atoms both refuse activation.

auto_traits.expansion: Every subject is checked against every trait in universe; groups are an exact cartesian compression, not a wildcard.

variants.invariant: Selections and generations form an exact nonempty ProjectSourceKey bijection.
variants.name: SelectedAggregate

variants.invariant: Selection receipts and evidence are an exact nonempty bijection and at least one source is unavailable.
variants.name: SelectionUnavailable

health_topology.rule: Health remains an MCP/HTTP wire contract backed by crate-private DTOs. The separate binary crate reaches it only through server_api::run; no health type, raw runtime, or server module is public Rust API.

atomization.activation_requirement: The pinned v10 rustdoc/HIR extractor MUST expand every category below into exact atoms and prove each old atom maps exactly once. Any unmapped old atom refuses activation.

categories.rationale: The public crate root remains the single namespace anchor; this row keeps only the root module itself, while every descendant is independently kept, replaced, removed, or introduced by another exact row.
All engine, protocol, CLI, watcher, Git, parser, persistence, STEL, and raw state modules become crate-private. Server entry is replaced by server_api and health remains wire-only.
Replace raw and degraded-capable state with lifecycle-owned runtime, source handle, strict runtime view, refusals, and receipts.
Replace free functions and authority-less results with handle methods returning typed Claim envelopes or the closed SourceRefusal algebra.
Replace direct mutation with managed observation and one lifecycle-owned refresh request.
Snapshot restore and persistence become private candidate-seed lifecycle work, never external publication authority.
Raw parsing and index-record constructors could bypass complete-candidate and authority publication rules.
No raw Git handle is exposed until a separately frozen authority-bearing operation exists.
STEL remains server-owned implementation detail. A future external telemetry API requires its own attested manifest amendment.
Deep reexports are raw bypasses and are not part of the managed V11 facade.

stel.future_rule: A public telemetry API requires a separately reviewed and attested manifest amendment.
